name: wled-mcp
description: Unofficial MCP server for WLED LED controllers over stdio or Streamable HTTP; not affiliated with the WLED project

WLED_MCP_CONFIG.description: Absolute path of the device inventory (TOML file) that lists your own WLED controllers

WLED_MCP_DATA_DIR.description: Absolute path of an existing, writable directory for the server's snapshots and stored data

uvx.description: Run the PyPI package with uvx over stdio; the server reads its inventory and data directory from the two environment variables
